apps.subtitle: Music & podcast player for iOS (Apollo)
apps.localizedDescription:
A free and open source music and podcast player for iOS.

• No ads
• Spotify-powered catalogue for songs, albums, artists and playlists
• Podcasts with publisher RSS audio and a YouTube fallback
• Background playback with lock screen controls
• Equalizer & audio normalization
• Queue management & listening history
• Synced lyrics (Musixmatch, Netease, Kugou, LRCLIB, Genius)
• Local library, playlists, downloads and backups
• Custom app icons

Requires iOS 26 or later. No account is required for the catalogue.
